proposed_widenings.name: DenyOpportunityAttackEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit rider 'can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn' maps to the v4 atom deny_opportunity_attack, but the Effect union in types.ts is restricted to DamageEffect | NoneEffect. The atom exists in v4 taxonomy but is absent from the surface type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: onHit multi-effect composite
proposed_widenings.justification: Shocking Grasp delivers two simultaneous on-hit effects: damage and deny_opportunity_attack. The current ActivationPhase has onHit: Effect (single). A composite form (e.g., onHit: ReadonlyArray<Effect>) is needed to represent spells with multiple co-occurring on-hit effects.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Lightning damage, and it can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

notes: Primary mechanics (melee spell attack, lightning damage, character-level cantrip scaling) encode cleanly into activation/attack_roll with threshold_tiers. The deny_opportunity_attack on-hit rider is omitted from the encoded JSON — the atom is in v4 but not in the Effect surface union. This is the same structural gap as ray_of_frost (modify_speed) and chill_touch (block_healing). The trace correctly reflects only the damage branch; the omission is documented here and in proposal-shocking_grasp.md.
